blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ethereum block 26224770 (2026-10-19): bC3M proxy 0x2f123cf3f37ce3328cc9b5b8415f9ec5109b45e7 resolves to the verified BackedTokenImplementation 0x28a0b491650fe761c8a66528422bc7ca24ecaeda. The implementation enforces a sanctions list on every transfer: _beforeTokenTransfer rejects a sanctioned sender or recipient and _spendAllowance rejects a sanctioned spender through the configured oracle 0x40C57923924B5c5c5455c48D93317139ADDaC8fb, which is non-zero and live. The owner 0x22f2dFE84a2EaCfE5d3cA81d26E610CB94eB1603 can replace that oracle; current enforcement blocks named addresses today. A pauser 0xdD276f57e40D745E09855BA5711613F5Da0C4A71 can additionally set a global transfer pause (isPaused()=false). There is no address freeze function, and burn(address,uint256) requires the burner role but reverts unless account is the burner itself or the token contract, so it cannot burn an arbitrary holder. The Pharos API publishes no per-chain supply for the eight authored deployments, so the Ethereum deployment is treated as material (fail closed). Direct Yes via the enforced sanctions denylist.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: bC3M is issuer-minted natively by Backed on each of the eight deployments (same token address via CREATE2); mint authority per chain is covered by the reviewed mint-authority controls. No third-party bridge carries the claim. Fantom was separately reviewed on September 15, 2026 as native issuance with a 3-of-5 minter, separate 2-of-3 token owner and single-EOA proxy upgrader; no Fantom bridge rail is asserted.

oracleRisk.summary: bC3M is a Backed Assets (JE) Limited tracker certificate. The 8 May 2026 base prospectus assigns valuation to the Issuer using Reference Sources, including exchange prices or underlying-issuer NAV. The issuer-deployed bC3M Price Feed at 0x83Ec02059F686E747392A22ddfED7833bA0d7cE3 uses BackedOracle 0xb239bd2216D1c8476f601e0d9b5FfAD556C59Cc4; the current implementation slot and exact runtime were verified at Ethereum block 26357851 (2026-11-06T19:18:11Z). Its values are pushed through UPDATER_ROLE, not independently aggregated. The 12 July 2023 factory deployment names bC3M and grants the initial updater 0x17603dDb4A4F8D7a7E1FC45fa0059aDc906c8600; this is historical, not a current signer census. latestRoundData() still returns round 920 with updatedAt 1776937321 (2026-04-23T09:42:01Z), so this feed does not establish a current executable redemption price. This review classifies issuer valuation and privileged publication, without asserting that redemption consumes that feed or that downstream borrower integrations are covered.

branchApplicability.rationale: The issuer terms value a tracker-certificate claim from the underlying ETF reference value. This is top-level certificate valuation, not a borrower-collateral liquidation engine. The named onchain publication artefact is separately identity-bound; neither a downstream lending-branch inventory nor use of that stale feed for current redemption is asserted.
